items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And we went to Chicago and played at the Savoy Ballroom the rest of that winter and all that summer with Bernie Young's band.

ctx.x: City Park, right across the street from Art. And one night we played with the house band at the Recreation Ballroom there. And we would play five nights or six nights a week and on Monday we'd have off and we'd give a colored dance.

So this one night we -- I'm ahead of myself, because before that I had gone -- before this I -- Eddie Inge had left the Milwaukee band, the Roof Garden. And they sent for me, to Minneapolis, to come and play with them on the Wisconsin Roof. Then we went to Chicago and played that winter. And we went to Chicago and played at the Savoy Ballroom the rest of that winter and all that summer with Bernie Young's band.
